notes.title: Version 1.0.4EA is released!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to release v1.0.4EA today.

Lots of bug fixes and stability improvements.

Also, there are now Leaderboards!

Thanks to all the beta testers this weekend.

Enjoy.
